title: Where Research Ideation Begins: Forward-Citation Supervision for Actionable Limitation Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23038v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated research ideation has advanced rapidly, with multi-agent workflows that generate whole research ideas end to end. These frameworks leave largely unexamined the step that seeds a good idea: identifying an actionable limitation from literature. In this paper, we focus on this first step in the research ideation pipeline. Starting from a pilot study, we find that as large language models (LLMs) scale from 0.6B to 32B parameters, they become far better at recognizing which limitation later work addressed, but no better at generating one, suggesting that the bottleneck lies in the supervision signal rather than model capacity. We therefore construct ActLim-Bench from forward citations, yielding 18,279 evidence-linked supervision triples with human verification. translated_title: 研究构思始于何处：基于前向引用监督的可执行局限性生成
translated_abstract: 自动化研究构思已取得快速发展，出现了能够端到端生成完整研究想法的多智能体工作流。然而，这些框架在很大程度上忽视了一个孕育好想法的关键步骤：从文献中识别出可执行的局限性。本文聚焦于研究构思流程中的这第一步。从一项试点研究出发，我们发现当大语言模型（LLM）的参数规模从0.6B扩展到32B时，它们在识别后续工作解决了哪些局限性方面能力显著提升，但在生成此类局限性方面却毫无改善，这表明瓶颈在于监督信号而非模型能力。因此，我们基于前向引用构建了ActLim-Bench，产生了18,279条经人工验证的、带有证据链接的监督三元组。基于这一信号，我们提出了一个三阶段后训练流程：监督微调、经验证器过滤的拒绝采样微调，以及基于……的强化学习（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现研究构思中“识别可执行局限性”的瓶颈在于监督信号而非模型规模，并基于前向引用构建了含18,279条人工验证监督三元组的ActLim-Bench数据集，通过三阶段后训练流程提升大模型从文献中生成可执行研究局限性的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the bottleneck in generating actionable research limitations lies in supervision signals rather than model capacity, and constructs ActLim-Bench with 18,279 human-verified evidence-linked supervision triples from forward citations, paired with a three-stage post-training pipeline to enhance LLMs' ability to identify actionable limitations from literature.
